_comment: Single source of truth for every number on thornveil.ai. Never hardcode a stat in a page; import from here. Updated as systems ship.

rigrun.name: RigRun
rigrun.summary: Classification-gated multi-domain LLM router. Three apps on one Go backend. NIST 800-53 controls implemented as discrete code paths.

pyros.name: Pyros
pyros.summary: Pure-Go safety engine that wraps any model in a 7-pillar pipeline. No Python, no CGO, one binary.

mycelium.name: Mycelium
mycelium.tagline: Keeps thinking when the mesh dies
mycelium.summary: Distributed mixture-of-experts inference. Substitute-on-failure dispatch keeps producing tokens when half the mesh goes dark.

auspex.name: Auspex
auspex.tagline: AI red team gated by Signet
auspex.summary: Autonomous offensive security with scope-as-code. End-to-end validated on adversarial Active Directory takeover with HMAC-chained replay.

signet.name: Signet
signet.summary: The model proposes; Signet authorizes. Capability-based safety gates for agentic LLMs.

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.summary: Algorithm-aware C-to-Rust translation. One command, local LLM, five mandatory correctness gates.

hawkstack.name: HawkStack
hawkstack.summary: Compute-aware neural architecture topology theory + perception backbone family.

meridian.name: Meridian
meridian.summary: Memory-safe Rust flight-control firmware. ArduPilot/PX4 alternative.

canopy.name: Canopy
canopy.summary: RF + acoustic + thermal + RID + ADS-B sensor fusion.

navigator.name: Navigator
navigator.tagline: Internal AI ops center, 9 production agents
navigator.summary: Agent Factory + 9 production agents + adaptive subsystems.
